message: Last week, I was cooking dinner and set off the smoke alarm—classic move, right? Just as I was waving a towel like a madwoman, my family group chat lit up with everyone checking if I was okay, offering tips on how to calm the alarm down, and sharing their own kitchen mishaps. 😂 It reminded me that having a solid escape plan is just as important as knowing how to prevent the smoke alarms from going off in the first place. Do you have a family plan in place?
